title: Flat constant-w fluid with CLASS PPF closure
faithful_claim: The DESI dark-energy parameterization admits a constant-w subclass. Replacing Lambda with a separately conserved w=-0.9 component defines a distinct flat GR background. A smooth CLASS PPF closure and fixed-reference conditional H0 test are declared consumer choices, not DESI fitted values or author scalar dynamics.

equations.locator: DESI HTML S1.E8-S1.E10 and S1.p6.3: CPL and constant-w subclass
equations.definitions: a=1/(1+z), a(today)=1; w=p_de/rho_de; w0 and wa dimensionless.
equations.domain: Flat GR FLRW; chosen w0=-0.9,wa=0 never crosses w=-1.

equations.definitions: Separate conservation d rho_de/d ln a=-3(1+w0)rho_de; density relative to its current positive value.
equations.domain: Noninteracting homogeneous fluid at a>0; chosen w0=-0.9 gives exponent0.3.

equations.locator: Flat specialization of DESI HTML S1.EGx2 (Eq6); CLASS thermal species retained separately
equations.definitions: Omega_bc=Omega_b+Omega_cdm; all densities use current critical density. Massive-neutrino thermal interpolation is computed by pinned CLASS; spatial curvature and Lambda are zero.
equations.domain: Same source-state species and finite positive-flatness branch as pinned external CLASS reference.

assumptions: One GR metric, flat FLRW and separate energy conservation; replace Lambda only.
Retain the explicit baryon/CDM/neutrino/photon, helium, HyRec, reionization, primordial and output state from the pinned external CLASS reference; no native Irreducible CMB claim.
Use CLASS phenomenological PPF perturbation closure with explicit cs2=1,c_gamma=0.4 and adiabatic initial conditions.
w0=-0.9 is a chosen example, not a DESI posterior mean or fitted scalar-field parameter.
At each H0 point recompute fractional density/flatness closure from fixed physical densities, including actual present massive-neutrino density.

minimal_test.question: Does the separately conserved constant-w branch change the conditional H0 fit to the same released DESI full13 BAO vector, and how do its separate primary-CMB scores compare?
observables: H(z),luminosity/comoving distances and predicted drag ruler
Separate linear and Halofit matter spectra

parameter_choices.closure: CLASS infers Omega_fld=1-Omega_k-Omega_b-Omega_cdm-Omega_gamma-Omega_ur-Omega_ncdm using current thermal neutrino density; no copied Planck Omega_m.

retained_reference.required_removal: Remove inherited Omega_fld=0 before merging chosen inputs; H0 becomes the one fitted coordinate, all other physical inputs remain fixed.

free_coordinate.name: H0
free_coordinate.role: One conditional fitted coordinate; consumer predeclares finite bounds and convergence budget.

parameter_choices.perturbation_identity: CLASS approximate PPF phenomenological closure, cs2=1,c_gamma=0.4, with nonzero fluid perturbations; not a scalar potential/microphysical model.

minimal_test.scope: Same dedicated Reproducible external CLASS prediction and retained-product official-clik workflow as LCDM. One conditional H0 fit to full13 DESI covariance, with all other physical/nuisance inputs fixed. Display BAO and primary CMB separately; SN remains separately conditional on its source contract.

falsification: An unconsumed control, negative inferred fluid density, mismatched release identity/axis, failed precision/support gate or numerical discrepancy outside the predeclared consumer budget refuses that attempt. A better conditional score is not evidence for a complete physical mechanism.
